title: hotfix: stabilize slo-enforcer backoff + regional failover (reduce thrashing)
author: Aisha Patel
body:
Motivation: Customer production incidents over the last 48 hours (see SRE-202) revealed a pathological interaction between the SLO enforcer backoff state machine and regional failover logic. When a region experienced capacity pressure and requests were routed away, the enforcer would immediately attempt to fail over and re-enqueue traffic into other regions without sufficient hysteresis or jitter. This caused repeated short-lived failovers and aggressive backoff resets (thrashing), increasing p99 latency and triggering additional load-shedding rounds.

This PR implements a targeted hotfix to stabilize the SLO enforcer: per-region backoff state, exponential backoff with capped amplification, randomized jitter on backoff windows, a minimum hysteresis period before allowing a region to be marked healthy again, and a small debounce on automatic regional failover decisions. The goal is to reduce oscillation while preserving the ability to move traffic away from degraded regions quickly.

Summary of changes: - Add pkg/slo/enforcer/backoff.go: per-region BackoffState with exponential backoff, cap, and jitter. - Update pkg/slo/enforcer/slo_enforcer.go: use per-region backoff and enforce hysteresis window (30s default) before re-accepting traffic. - Add backoff unit and integration tests: backoff_test.go and a short integration test that simulates regional capacity blips. - Observability: add slo_enforcer_backoff_{region,level,action} counters and a gauge for current_hysteresis_remaining in observability/metrics. - Deployment: increase readiness/liveness TTLs and add a feature flag slo_enforcer.enable_per_region_backoff in deploy/k8s/slo-enforcer-deploy.yaml for canary rollout. - Docs: rollout notes in docs/engineering/slo-enforcer-rollout.md and a short troubleshooting section.

Testing and verification: - Unit tests added for backoff math and state transitions. - Integration test simulates 3-region topology with intermittent capacity pressure; asserts region is not flapped more than once per hysteresis window. - Local load test (k6) run in staging with canary feature-flag enabled for 48h. Observed p99 token latency drop by ~18% under synthetic blips and a 40% reduction in region-switch events. - CI initially failed on a flaky test (slo_enforcer_test: TestQueueOrdering) — test was stabilized and retried; subsequent CI run passed.

Rollout plan: - Feature flag default off. - Canary: enable flag for 5% of traffic in staging and 1 internal customer in prod for 2 hours. - Ramp to 25% if metrics stable (no increase in p99, failovers reduced). - Full rollout by toggling flag to on after 24h with no regressions.

Related: ENG-3421 covers long-term rework of the enforcer state machine (follow-up PR planned). This hotfix is intentionally small and reversible.

Checklist: - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration test added - [x] Observability added - [x] Rollout notes documented - [x] Feature-flagged for canary

If after merge we still see flapping we will revert the flag and iterate; this change is timeboxed as a hotfix and tracked in SRE-202.
commits: b1a3c9f: fix(backoff): add per-region BackoffState with jitter and cap
d4e2f11: feat(enforcer): wire per-region backoff into decision path and add hysteresis
a8f7c32: test: add backoff unit and integration tests
c5b9d20: docs: rollout notes and troubleshooting for slo-enforcer
e2d4120: deploy: add feature flag and adjust readiness/liveness TTLs
review_comments: Ethan Liu: Can we expose the hysteresis window as a flag with a safe default? (answered: added feature flag and env override, default 30s)
María Gómez: Suggest adding additional metrics to detect when jitter is preventing recovery. (answered: added gauge current_hysteresis_remaining and backoff_level tags)
Liam O'Connor: unit test flakes observed locally; please add deterministic random seed for jitter in tests. (answered: tests use deterministic seed and CI shows stability)
Ethan Liu: Approve after CI green and rollout notes. (approved)
CI Bot: initial unit-tests failed (flaky TestQueueOrdering); reran and passed on second attempt
release_notes: Hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and regional failover. Adds per-region backoff with jitter and hysteresis to reduce failover thrashing, new metrics, and a feature flag for canary rollout. Improves p99 under transient regional capacity blips.
notes_for_ops: Feature-flagged change. If flapping observed after rollout, disable slo_enforcer.enable_per_region_backoff via config map and restart enforcer pods. Metric to watch: slo_enforcer_region_switch_count and slo_enforcer_backoff_level{level="high"}.
